name: MP1584EN
description: The 28 V, 3 A non-synchronous buck found on countless mini buck modules; adjustable 100 kHz–1.5 MHz, OK for repairs and clones of those boards.
notes: Not recommended for new designs: MPS points to the MP2338.
Non-synchronous: needs an external Schottky diode; FREQ resistor sets 100 kHz–1.5 MHz.

en.note: Floating EN is pulled to ~3.0 V by an internal 1 µA source, so the chip also runs with EN open. Rising threshold 1.5 V typ (1.35-1.65), falling 1.2 V (300 mV hysteresis). The page-1 3.3 V app and Fig. 4 µse R5 100 k VIN->EN, R6 24.9 k EN->GND: VIN_on ~ 1.5 V*(1 + R5/R6) ~ 7.5 V. EN falls under 'All other pins -0.3 to +6 V', so size R6 so that EN stays <= 6 V at max VIN (100 k/24.9 k gives 5.6 V at 28 V). Datasheet advises programming the EN UVLO to >= VOUT + 3 V so BST stays charged at light load.

comp.note: GEA (error amp transconductance) 60 µA/V typ (40-80), GCS (COMP to current sense transconductance) 9 A/V, AVEA (EA voltage gain) 200 V/V. Datasheet: DC gain AVDC = RLOAD*GCS*AVEA*VFB/VOUT. Poles fP1 = GEA/(2*pi*C3*AVEA), fP2 = 1/(2*pi*C2*RLOAD); zero fZ1 = 1/(2*pi*C3*R3); ESR zero fESR = 1/(2*pi*C2*RESR); optional third pole fP3 = 1/(2*pi*C6*R3). Crossover fC ~ fS/10. Procedure: (1) R3 = (2*pi*C2*fC/(GEA*GCS)) * (VOUT/VFB); (2) C3 > 4/(2*pi*R3*fC) (fZ1 below fC/4); (3) C6 only if 1/(2*pi*C2*RESR) < fS/2, then C6 = C2*RESR/R3. Network: COMP -> R3 -> C3 -> GND (series), C6 COMP -> GND. Table 3 (VOUT / L / C2 / R3 / C3 / C6): 1.8 V / 4.7 µH / 47 µF / 105 k / 100 pF / none; 2.5 V / 4.7-6.8 µH / 22 µF / 54.9 k / 220 pF / none; 3.3 V / 6.8-10 µH / 22 µF / 68.1 k / 220 pF / none; 5 V / 15-22 µH / 22 µF / 100 k / 150 pF / none; 12 V / 22-33 µH / 22 µF / 147 k / 150 pF / none. COMP clamped 0.9-2.0 V; never pull COMP above 2.6 V.

extras.note: Rfreq(kΩ) = 180000 / [fs(kHz)]^1.1 -> 193 kΩ for 500 kHz (nearest E96 196 k). The datasheet's 500 kHz typical app (page 1) and the 1.8 V app µse 200 k (~485 kHz by the formula). EC table: 100 k -> 900 kHz. Range 100 kHz-1.5 MHz.

notes: NOT RECOMMENDED FOR NEW DESIGNS: the datasheet is watermarked 'Not recommended for new designs, refer to MP2338'.
Non-synchronous, peak-current-mode, external compensation on COMP; pulse-skipping at light load; fs set by FREQ resistor (100 kHz-1.5 MHz).
Current limit 4.7 A typ (4.0 min). Min on-time and min off-time both 100 ns (design-guaranteed).

Inductor: datasheet rule is ripple ~30 % of the MAXIMUM SWITCH CURRENT LIMIT (not of Iout; ~1.2-1.4 A), keep peak below the current limit. L = VOUT/(fS*dIL)*(1 - VOUT/VIN). Table 1 lists 3.3-22 µH parts. kInd left null because the rule is not Iout-based.

lTable lUh values are the UPPER end of the Table 3 inductor ranges (2.5 V 4.7-6.8, 3.3 V 6.8-10, 5 V 15-22, 12 V 22-33 µH); Table 3 does not state fs. The 3.3 V row matches the 500 kHz page-1 app (10 µH, 22 µF, 124 k/40.2 k). The 5 V Fig. 4 app µses 15 µH with Rfreq 100 k (~900 kHz). rTopK filled only where a datasheet schematic gives it.

Feedback: VOUT = VFB*(R1+R2)/R2. R2 typical 40.2 kΩ; with it R1 = 50.25*(VOUT - 0.8) kΩ (text: 127 k for 3.3 V; page-1 schematic µses 124 k). About 20 µA of BST-circuit current reaches the output at no load: keep R2 under ~40 k, i.e. IO + VO/(R1+R2) > 20 µA.
Input cap: ceramic preferred (typical 10 µF/50 V); RMS rating > half the load current. If electrolytic or tantalum is µsed, add a 0.1 µF ceramic close to the IC.
Output cap: ceramic, tantalum or low-ESR electrolytic allowed; datasheet circuits µse 22 µF (47 µF at 1.8 V) 6.3 V ceramic. With high-ESR caps add C6 per the comp procedure.

Bootstrap: 100 nF BST-SW. External bootstrap diode (1N4148 or BAT54) from a 5 V rail to BST recommended when VIN <= 5 V, VOUT/VIN > 65 %, or a 5 V rail exists. At light load keep VIN - VOUT > 3 V to refresh BST.
VIN 4.5-28 V (abs max 30 V), VOUT 0.8-25 V. Rated -20 to +85 C ambient.
Layout: minimise the CIN / high-side switch / Schottky loop; ceramic bypass at VIN; feedback and comp parts close to the IC and away from SW.

Datasheet inconsistency: Fig. 3 (1.8 V, VIN 4.5-28 V) µses R5 100 k / R6 59 k, which puts EN at ~10 V at 28 V VIN, above the 6 V 'all other pins' abs max (no EN clamp is documented). Prefer the 100 k / 24.9 k divider or leave EN floating.
design.pages: MP1584 Rev. 1.0 (8/8/2011); the MPS URL is behind a JS challenge, so the identical MPS PDF was read via the JLCPCB C15051 datasheet link. Page-1 typical app (3.3 V, 500 kHz: 10 µH, 22 µF, R1 124 k, R2 40.2 k, R3 68.1 k, C3 220 pF, R4 200 k, R5 100 k, R6 24.9 k, C4 100 nF, C1 10 µF/50 V) p1; abs max (VIN 30 V, BST-SW 6 V, all other pins 6 V) p2; EC table (VFB 0.8 V, ILIM 4.7 A, GCS 9 A/V, GEA 60 µA/V, AVEA 200, fosc 900 kHz @ 100 k, min on/off 100 ns, EN 1.5 V/300 mV) p3; pin functions p4; EN, COMP clamps, BST p8; Rfreq formula, 20 µA BST bleed p9; FB divider, inductor 30 % rule p10; Table 1 inductors, Table 2 diodes, Cin p11; Cout, compensation equations p12; Table 3 + R3/C3/C6 procedure p13; external BST diode, VIN-VOUT > 3 V p14; Fig. 3 (1.8 V) and Fig. 4 (5 V) apps p15; layout p16.
